mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobseeker_applicant a JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = a.JOB_POSTS_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}

SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore FROM company_matching cm JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} ORDER BY cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT DESC, cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.HOPE_JOB, '$[0]')) AS hopeJob, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore, cp.KEYSKILL AS tags FROM company_matching cm JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX LEFT JOIN cover_posts cp ON cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX = ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} ORDER BY cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT DESC, cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX DESC LIMIT 3
